- Thai red or green curry paste (1–2 tbsp) — the base heat and aromatics.  
- Nam prik pao (Thai roasted chili paste) (1 tbsp) — adds smoky sweet heat and depth.

- Galangal or lemongrass (finely sliced, 1 tsp minced lemongrass or 1–2 thin slices galangal) — adds citrusy/peppery complexity.  
- A splash of coconut cream at the end — richer, silkier finish.

If you tell me which of these you actually used (or what you learned last night), I can save it to memory or add it to a recipe email/note for you. Which would you like?
